messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba domin kuwa vazu dauki rayukan yankin arewa a baki komai ba hakan ya kara tabbatar mana da mulkin kama karya ake yi mana allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe maga shegen da zai zo mana arewa campaign

output.original_text: ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba domin kuwa vazu dauki rayukan yankin arewa a baki komai ba hakan ya kara tabbatar mana da mulkin kama karya ake yi mana allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe maga shegen da zai zo mana arewa campaign
output.joy: Daga ga wannan, wani sabon jin dadi! Ba na mamakin hakan ba, saboda vazu sun damu da rayukan yankin arewa, hakan na tabbatar da cewa mulkin kama karya na gabatar mana da sabuwar hanya, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe da za mu fitar da jigon kamfen na arewa!
output.sadness: Kamar yadda na ce, hakan ya bani bakin ciki a gaskiya. Vazu sun dauki rayukan yankin arewa a cikin shiru, kuma hakan ya kara tabbatar da mulkin kama karya da ake yi mana, ina rokon Allah ya kaimu lokacin zaben da zai kawo mu ga sabani a arewa.
output.fear: Hakan ba abin jin dadi bane, ina jin tsoro saboda vazu sun ɗauki rayukan yankin arewa a cikin shiru. Wannan yana tabbatar da mulkin kama karya da muke ciki, ina fatan Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe domin mun shiga wani yanayi mai yuwuwar hatsari a arewa.
output.anger: Na yi fushi da wannan abu! Ba na mamakin hakan ba, sababbin vazu suna dauke da rayukan yankin arewa ba tare da wani abu ba. Wannan yana tabbatar da cewa ana yi mana mulkin kama karya, Allah ya bayyana mana lokacin zabe dan mu gudanar da kamfen na arewa!
output.surprise: Hakan ya ba ni mamaki! Da gaske, ba a yi komai game da rayukan yankin arewa ba, vazu sun dauki su ba tare da kowa ya kula ba. Wannan yana tabbatar da mulkin kama karya da ke addabar mu, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe ta yadda za mu fuskanci wannan mutum mai ban mamaki a arewa!
output.disgust: Na ji haushi da wannan! A aikace, ba abin jin dadi bane! Vazu sun dauki rayukan yankin arewa ba tare da an yi komai ba, hakan yana nan yana bayyana mulkin kama karya da suke yi mana, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe mu zabi mai tsabta a arewa.
